description: Election Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2024 Code of Conduct.
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively concerns electoral processes, specifically the issuance of a Code of Conduct for political parties, independent groups, and candidates for a Parliamentary Election. It is published by the Election Commission under the authority of the Parliamentary Elections Act and its amendments. The content details rules and regulations governing election conduct, which falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
